card.name: Inside brand and Latin names
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece partway through or at the end of a proper name that is still being spelled out. Examples are capitalised brand names (RYLAZE, CEREZYME, KISUNLA), bacterial species (infantis, influenzae) and place or surname pieces.

modes.label: Brand drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of an all-caps brand name, usually right before 'is contraindicated' or a dosing/safety sentence.

modes.label: Other proper names
modes.description: Middle piece of a surname or place name in general text.
